items.title: Al Vollmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 8, 2017
items.q: A good friend of mine from high school... he felt like, you know Ben Webster should have been given a stipend...

ctx.x: Sure. And at first I was really surprised, because I had the same thing, like oh my God these are people I’ve been listening to all my life, don’t they have it made?

A good friend of mine from high school that I — he was the other jazz guy in the high school and we kept up for a long time, he felt like, you know Ben Webster should have been given a stipend of $10,000 a year in order to stay in the country so he didn’t have to live in Denmark.
Why is it? Why is jazz not —
